parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region Object Storage Service (OSS) URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Input limits:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, or BMP.
- Image size: No larger than 4 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must be less than 2000 pixels, and the face must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image resizing](~~44688~~).
